Example Enrichment Results

Source: R/data.R
exampleEnrichment.Rd

fgsea results for the TCGA colon adenocarcinoma data analyzed in Vitting-Seerup & Sandelin (2017), where gene-set enrichment was done both for differentially expressed genes ("Expression") and differentially spliced genes ("Splicing"). Only gene sets with an adjusted p-value below 0.05 are included, a subset of 197 gene sets.

Usage

exampleEnrichment

Format

A tibble with 206 rows (one per gene set and source) and 5 columns:

source

The analysis the gene set was found in: "Expression" or "Splicing".

pathway

The gene set name.

enrichment_score

Normalized enrichment score (NES) from fgsea.

pval

p-value from fgsea.

padj

Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value from fgsea.

Source

Computed with fgsea::fgseaMultilevel() on MSigDB gene sets; see inst/scripts/make-exampleEnrichment.R. Vitting-Seerup K, Sandelin A. The Landscape of Isoform Switches in Human Cancers. Mol Cancer Res. 2017;15(9):1206-1220.
